venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
dek: Baugh was the best player on the field. Faulkner would not let FAU play him one way.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — written from snaps sat on Charles full broadcast. Not every snap. Fan rail empty.
headline: You cannot put a card on this offense.

offense.body:
Saturday was 66–21 because Baugh was the best player on the field and Faulkner would not let FAU play him one way.

Florida’s first answer is not a trick. Shotgun. Baugh. Then they put Brown next to Philo, send the extra man across, and make you pick the mesh. Then they just hand it inside. The line fires. Seven yards to the 44. Denaud is in the pile.

Wilson is not sitting in the grass. Philo has time. He throws him down the sideline. Wilson goes to the ground around the 20. Nineteen yards.

Brown’s 49: the throw is a short one. The tape I sat is him already gone down the sideline. First man is late. He scores. Seven plays, 94 yards.

When they get to the 8 after Abrams, they will pull a lineman and run the edge. They also snap one over Philo’s head and lose twenty. Both are on the same trip.

Third quarter, third-and-2. Baugh is already past the 40. A man is on the ground behind him. Brown is outside. That is the 61. Everybody knew and it did not matter.
bullets: Creep up for Baugh and Brown scores from 49.
Follow the fake and the ball goes the other way.
Stay put and Baugh rips off 61 when everybody knew.

defense.body:
FAU never huddles. Shotgun. The first drive is all short throws. Florida is four down, corners yards off. Chiles breaks on one and knocks it out. Third-and-10, Veltkamp goes the sideline anyway. Coleman is over the top of it at Florida’s 5. Opening drive, gone.

FAU will keep throwing it short until you stand there. They get to the 1 and Florida has the bodies. Ervin still walks it in. Veltkamp walks one in from 7 when the edge leaves. Ninety plays.
bullets: The short throw stayed open. Ninety plays.
White moves Woods so the tackle never settles.
Coleman sells the middle, then intercepts it at Florida’s 5.

specials.body: Durkin from 53. Clean. Florida never punts. FAU’s 18-yard punt starts Florida’s second score.
bullets: FAU’s 18-yard punt starts Florida’s second score.

nextWeek.look: They will throw it short and the quarterback will run it. Sixkiller is their guy. Hand it to Baugh. Ask a new question. Stand on the short throw. Keep Woods on the outside when Sixkiller runs it.
